classification: SOURCE-FIXED; PRODUCTION AUTH DELIVERY EXTERNALLY BLOCKED
sourceFixed: Production hides Google, Apple and phone methods unless their exact public readiness flag is true.
Production email account creation, one-time codes and password reset remain disabled until custom delivery is attested.
Existing members can still use email and password without claiming production email delivery.
Development and test forms remain reachable without weakening the production default.
Cloudflare GitHub deployment defaults every provider-readiness variable to false.

externalBlockers.detail: The production Supabase Google provider has no client ID or client secret and is disabled.
externalBlockers.requiredEvidence: Create or supply an authorized Google OAuth web client, register the exact Supabase callback, enable Google in Supabase, execute sign-in and sign-out, then set VITE_AUTH_GOOGLE_ENABLED=true.

externalBlockers.detail: Custom SMTP is disabled; Supabase default SMTP is restricted to organization-team addresses and is not a production delivery service.
externalBlockers.requiredEvidence: Supply custom SMTP credentials for an OCADE-approved sender, enable the live setting, and execute confirmation, one-time-code and recovery delivery to a non-team address before setting VITE_AUTH_EMAIL_DELIVERY_READY=true.

prohibitedInference: Correct redirect URLs do not prove Google sign-in.
An enabled email provider does not prove production message delivery.
Source tests do not prove a delivered message or a real provider account.
